title: Choux Pastry (Profiteroles)
description: Light, crisp, and ready to cradle cream — the classic French pastry that never goes out of style.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 210°C. Line baking trays with parchment paper.
In a medium saucepan, combine water, milk, butter, salt, and sugar. Heat until butter melts and mixture begins to simmer.
Add flour all at once, stirring vigorously until the mixture pulls away from the sides of the pan and forms a smooth ball.
Transfer dough to a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment. Add eggs one at a time on low speed, mixing well after each.
After the last egg, increase speed to high and mix 5–10 minutes until dough is smooth, glossy, and slightly elastic.
Pipe or spoon small portions (~1.5–2 inch) onto prepared trays, leaving ~5 cm space between each.
Lightly sprinkle cold water on the tray to help steam and maintain shape during baking.
Bake at 210°C for 10 minutes, then reduce to 165°C for 10–15 minutes until puffed and crisp. Do not open the oven early.
Cool completely on a wire rack before filling with stiff custard, ice cream, or flavored creams.
